wishlist_discovery_intent.label: Wishlist & Discovery Intent
verbatim_quotes: Saved 5 dresses for my birthday next month. Waiting for prices to drop!
I always wishlist things during EOSR and then forget to buy. The reminders feature would be amazing.
My wishlist is basically my wardrobe wishlist — I have 140 items saved. I keep revisiting to see if prices drop.
Added this kurta set three weeks ago, finally bought it during the sale. The wishlist was my reminder system.
I treat the wishlist like a Pinterest board. Half the items I save, I never intend to buy — just aspirational.
The wishlisted items notification for price drops is the BEST feature. Saved me ₹800 on a blazer.

purchase_blockers.label: Purchase Blockers
verbatim_quotes: Item went out of stock right while it was in my cart. So frustrating.
I was ready to buy but couldn't find my size in the color I wanted — ended up buying nothing.
The return policy for sale items is super restrictive. That's why I hesitate to buy discounted items.
Tried to checkout 3 times, each time it failed. Just gave up eventually.
Reviews said the product was good but photos didn't match reality. Didn't trust enough to buy.
Delivery estimate said 10-14 days which was too late for the occasion I needed it for.

fit_size_anxiety.label: Fit & Size Anxiety
verbatim_quotes: Size chart said M but it fits like XS. Sizing is super inconsistent across brands.
Ordered L because the reviews said to size up. Still too small. No standardization at all.
I wish they had try-on AR like some international apps. Myntra sizing is all over the place.
Had to return 3 jeans before I found one that fit. The size guides are useless.
The model in photos is clearly a size S. Hard to visualize how it'll look on a size M-L body.
I specifically check reviews for fit before buying now. Photos alone are not enough.

price_value_sensitivity.label: Price & Value Sensitivity
verbatim_quotes: Overpriced at MRP. Will only order during the End of Reason Sale.
Other shopping platforms have different prices for the same brands. I comparison shop regularly.
Price dropped ₹400 two days after I bought it. Super frustrating with no price protection.
Only buy during Big Fashion Festival or EOSR. Prices are just not reasonable otherwise.
Compared the same kurta on Myntra and other sites. Myntra was most competitive during sale.
Sale prices are attractive but the MRP seems artificially inflated to make the discount look better.

social_occasion_validation.label: Social & Occasion Validation
verbatim_quotes: Needed a wedding guest kurta urgently. Found great styling photos in the reviews section!
I bought this for my office Diwali party. The sequin work is gorgeous in person.
My friend wore this to her brother's wedding and looked stunning. I immediately bought it.
Instagram influencer wore something similar. Found a cheaper version on Myntra and wishlisted it.
Bought this for my sister's engagement. The color is exactly as shown — very satisfied.
Festival season shopping — saved 12 items for Navratri. Ended up buying 4 of them.

cross_platform_research.label: Cross-Platform Research
verbatim_quotes: Checked YouTube try-on haul before ordering to verify the exact color.
Reddit r/IndianFashionAddicts recommended this brand. Came to Myntra to buy it.
Saw this on Instagram, searched on Myntra. The price here is competitive.
Watched 3 YouTube reviews of this shoe before trusting the size guide enough to order.
Instagram saved this outfit, found the exact kurta on Myntra after reverse image searching.
Read reviews on Myntra, then checked Reddit discussions, then finally bought.

comparison_shortlisting.label: Comparison & Shortlisting
verbatim_quotes: Shortlisted two black blazers on Myntra, comparing fit charts.
Had 3 sarees shortlisted for a month. Finally picked the one with most positive reviews.
Can't decide between two kurta sets. Both wishlisted. Waiting for one to go on sale to decide.
Comparing this with a similar ethnic set on other sites. Price difference is marginal.
Shortlisted 6 gym sets. Narrowed to 2 based on reviews. Still deciding between them.
The wishlist lets me compare items side by side. Wish it had a proper compare feature though.

post_purchase_feedback.label: Post-Purchase Regret
verbatim_quotes: Fabric is very thin compared to how vibrant it looks on screen.
Color is completely different from photos. The product photos are misleading.
Expected premium quality based on the price. Got fast fashion quality.
The embroidery started coming off after first wash. Very disappointed.
Loved the style but the stitching quality is poor. Not worth the price.
Photos show a flowy dress, got a stiff one. Return process was smooth at least.
